description: Comments rail listing the document's comment threads (via TmDocumentCommentThread) with a visible/total count header, a new-comment button and composer, and filter and sort selectors. Raises callbacks for creating, replying, editing, resolving, reopening, deleting, and selecting comments.

parameters.name: Comments
parameters.description: Comment threads to display.

parameters.name: CanComment
parameters.description: Whether a comment operation is running.

parameters.name: CanDeleteOwnComments
parameters.description: Whether the current user can resolve or reopen comments.

parameters.name: CanResolve
parameters.description: Whether the current user can add comments or replies.

parameters.name: CanStartComment
parameters.description: Current author identifier used for ownership checks.

parameters.name: ComposerOpen
parameters.description: Current draft anchor when the new comment composer is open.

parameters.name: CurrentAuthorId
parameters.description: Whether the current user can delete comment threads they own.

parameters.name: DraftAnchor
parameters.description: Comment threads to display.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Selected comment thread id.

parameters.name: FilterChanged
parameters.description: Current comment filter.

parameters.name: IsBusy
parameters.description: Whether comments are loading.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Raised when the comment sort mode changes.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: Whether a new comment can be started from the current selection.

parameters.name: OnBeginComment
parameters.description: Optional status message.

parameters.name: OnCancelComment
parameters.description: Raised when a new comment is submitted.

parameters.name: OnCreateComment
parameters.description: Raised when a new comment flow should begin.

parameters.name: OnDeleteComment
parameters.description: Raised when a comment should be reopened.

parameters.name: OnEditComment
parameters.description: Raised when a reply is submitted.

parameters.name: OnReopenComment
parameters.description: Raised when a comment should be resolved.

parameters.name: OnReplyComment
parameters.description: Raised when the new comment composer is cancelled.

parameters.name: OnResolveComment
parameters.description: Raised when an existing comment entry is edited.

parameters.name: OnSelectComment
parameters.description: Raised when a comment should be deleted.

parameters.name: SelectedCommentId
parameters.description: Whether the new comment composer is open.

parameters.name: SortMode
parameters.description: Raised when the comment filter changes.

parameters.name: SortModeChanged
parameters.description: Current comment sort mode.

parameters.name: StatusMessage
parameters.description: Optional mention provider reused by comment composers.
